MELAS defines mitochondrial metabolic encephalomyopathy; hearing loss affects roughly 40-70% across MELAS, though MTTH-specific frequency is uncertain.
Clostridial infection produces a neurotoxin that disables inhibitory neurotransmission; spasms do not establish intrinsic skeletal-muscle injury.
Preeclampsia is defined by hypertension and systemic endothelial dysfunction; renal glomerular injury with proteinuria is a major diagnostic criterion.
Squamous blepharitis affects the eyelid margin, included in the ocular axis; inflammation alone does not establish an immune-mediated mechanism.
